title: The Heavenly Eye Finally Appears
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji's voice echoed through the secret realm, the pressure of the Heavenly Eye suddenly dissipating—yet somewhere beyond the Thirty-Third Heaven, a pair of eyes that transcended time and space slowly opened.

text.content: The darkness in the depths of the ruins seemed torn open by some ancient force, a suffocating pressure pouring out from the crack. Chen Ji felt as if all the blood in his body was freezing, every bone crying out under this pressure. Yet his gaze remained calm, even a slight smile playing at the corners of his mouth—the old thing had finally shown itself.

dialogue.content: Junior, you've finally arrived. Ten thousand years, I've waited too long for this moment.

text.content: As the voice fell, a massive eye slowly manifested in the void. The pupil was deep as an abyss, as if containing the chaos of the world's beginning; within the iris, countless stars twinkled, as if an entire world floated within. The true projection of the Heavenly Eye was ten thousand times more terrifying than Chen Ji had imagined.

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) Ten thousand years? Senior, your words are overly arrogant. In the end, you're just an old thing hiding behind the scenes, manipulating pieces.

text.content: Before the words even finished, that massive eye slightly condensed, the invisible pressure suddenly increasing tenfold. The ground beneath Chen Ji's feet crumbled inch by inch, blood seeping from the corner of his lips. Yet his smile deepened—not from stubbornness, but because he had finally seen through his opponent's cards. This pressure, though strong, was not unbearable.

At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's embrace violently trembled, and faded yellow patterns of the fourth layer's seal appeared on its surface. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul urgently rang in his mind: 'Not good, it wants to directly erase you! Quickly, unseal the fourth layer!'

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye descends, Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.description: Force unseal the fourth layer of the Tianji Record using Heavenly Fate Value as the price, gaining the qualification to converse with Heaven, but Heavenly Fate Value will plummet.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value will drop to dangerous levels
choices.process_label: 天机录第四层封印崩解

text.content: Chen Ji, without hesitation, pressed his hand onto the fragment, low voice: 'Unseal!' Heavenly Fate Value rushed out like a tide, the fourth layer of the Tianji Record shattered. A brilliant light erupted from within him, shooting straight toward that massive eye.

dialogue.content: Oh? Interesting. Ten thousand years without seeing anyone, finally there's an ant who dares to look straight at me.

choices.text: Test the Heavenly Secrets with Words
choices.description: Don't rashly unseal, use rhetoric to probe the Heavenly Eye's purpose,争取更多情报.

text.content: Chen Ji wiped the blood from his lips, unhurriedly straightening his robes: 'Since Senior has waited ten thousand years, surely it's not simply to crush an ant. This junior would like to know—what exactly does Senior wish to obtain from this junior?'

dialogue.content: What I want has never been you. The Tianji Record is the key—and you are merely the vessel that carries it.

choices.description: Don't reveal the unsealing intention, secretly contact Mo Xiansheng to prepare counterattack methods.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly, his mind sinking into the Tianji Record, rapidly exchanging with Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. After a moment, a barely noticeable smile curved his lips—he had already mastered the unsealing method for the fourth layer, just waiting for the right moment.

dialogue.content: (In the mind) Be careful, it's testing your limits. The skeletal anomaly three months from now is its scheme, but also its weakness!

text.content: The Heavenly Eye slightly condensed, seemingly not expecting this ant to have such courage. After a moment of silence, that aged voice sounded again: 'In three months, the skeletal anomaly will sweep across the Nine Provinces.届时，天机录完整者将成为唯一救世主——或毁灭者。你，想怎么选？'

Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. The skeletal anomaly—that was a scene he had deduced countless times with the Tianji Record, blurred yet filled with ominous foreboding. Countless white bones surging from the earth, living beings perished, the world transformed. He had always thought it was Heaven's punishment, never expecting it was a scheme set up by Heaven itself.

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) So Senior began arranging this ten thousand years ago, just to wait for a vessel capable of carrying the Tianji Record? Then at the crucial moment... make him make a choice?

text.content: The Heavenly Eye did not deny, the light flowing within that deep pupil seemed to mock his naivety. 'Correct. The Tianji Record chose you because you are sufficiently despicable—for your sister, you would sacrifice everything. This kind of person is easiest to control.'

choice.prompt: After the Heavenly Eye reveals the truth, how does Chen Ji respond—

choices.description: Confront Heaven's arrogance, question why it has the right to decide the fates of all beings.

text.content: Chen Ji threw his head back and laughed wildly, the laughter echoing through the secret realm, making the surrounding rock walls hum. 'Excellent! Excellent, Heaven! Excellent, chess master who decides the fates of all! But have you ever thought—why should YOU be the one to choose?'

dialogue.content: (Silence for a moment) Because I... am the will of this world.

choices.description: Don't engage in direct confrontation, analyze gaps in Heaven's words,寻找反击机会.
choices.risk_hint: Requires Time, Heaven May Lose Patience

text.content: Chen Ji收起笑容，眼中闪过一丝精光。'Senior says I am a vessel—but if the vessel shatters, wouldn't Senior need to find another? Three months' time,足够您找到替代品吗？'

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye slightly contracted, seemingly not expecting him to say such words. 'Are you threatening me?'

choices.description: Use Chen Nian's existence to counter Heaven—Heavenly Fate Lock can interfere with the Tianji Record, which is a flaw in Heaven's scheme.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice suddenly cooled: 'Chen Nian—Heavenly Fate Lock. Senior thinks hiding her in the Holy Sect ensures absolute safety? But her ability to interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight—isn't that your greatest weakness?'

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye abruptly contracted, a chilling killing intent almost solidifying into form. 'You—know of her existence?'

text.content: The air in the secret realm seemed to freeze. Chen Ji could feel Heaven's killing intent pressing down like a physical force, yet he also keenly caught that trace of... wavering. The Heavenly Eye, the unchanging will through ages, actually lost composure over a woman's name. Chen Nian, your existence is more important than I imagined.
The Heavenly Eye slowly turned; after a moment it恢复了平静，但那瞳孔深处的光芒明显比方才暗淡了几分。'有意思。你比我预想的要危险得多。'苍老的声音响起，'既然如此，本座给你一个机会——完成三个月后的任务，本座放你妹妹一条生路。否则……'

choice.prompt: After the Heavenly Eye sets its terms, how does Chen Ji respond—

choices.text: Pretend to Agree to Buy Time
choices.description: First stabilize Heaven, secretly plan to find a way to break the situation.
choices.risk_hint: May Be Seen Through by Heaven

text.content: Chen Ji沉吟片刻，拱手道：'Senior既然有此言，晚辈愿意考虑。只是三个月后的尸骨异象，究竟需要晚辈做什么，还请Senior明示。'

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye slightly narrowed,似乎在审视他的真诚度。'很好。本座会在合适的时机告诉你。现在……先完成你该做的事。'威压缓缓消散，天眼逐渐隐入虚空。

choices.description: Make no compromises, directly declare war on Heaven.

text.content: Chen Ji猛地抬起头，眼神如刀：'不必了。Senior的'恩赐'，陈某不稀罕。我妹妹的命，我自己来救。至于您的棋局——从今日起，我陈机不玩了。'

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye骤然爆发出滔天威压，却在即将碾碎陈机的瞬间停住。'……有意思。万年来，你是第一个敢对本座说不的人。'声音渐远，'那就让本座看看，你能走多远。'

choices.description: Neither directly refuse nor agree, demand more chips.

text.content: Chen Ji整了整衣襟，淡淡道：'晚辈并非不识抬举。只是空口承诺，难以让人安心。Senior若真有诚意，不妨先告知——尸骨异象的真相，以及我妹妹目前的处境。'

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye沉默了许久，最终发出一声意味深长的笑。'好一个讨价还价的棋子。罢了，本座今日心情好，便告诉你——尸骨异象，本座也控制不了。而你那妹妹……是本座留的后手。'

text.content: The Heavenly Eye彻底消散，秘境恢复了死寂。Chen Ji单膝跪地，大口喘息。方才的交锋看似平淡，实则每一秒都在生死边缘。天命值所剩无几，但他得到了比天命值更重要的东西——天道的底牌，以及三个月的时间。

dialogue.content: (In the mind rings) 做得好。尸骨异象连天道都无法控制，这意味着什么，你应该明白——那是一个变数，一个打破棋局的机会。

text.content: Chen Ji缓缓站起身，目光穿透秘境望向远方。Chen Nian，哥哥来了。三个月的时间，足够他布局一切。天道以为他是棋子，却不知他早已在棋盘之外落下了关键的一子。秘境外，晨曦初现；而在三十三重天外，一双跨越时空的眼睛缓缓睁开，饶有兴致地注视着这一切。'有趣……非常有趣。'
